Using Lunori.

Lunori is an independent translation tool by Sergei Nikolenko. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, Google, or Vercel.

This early release is provided without a service-level guarantee. Translations can be incomplete or inaccurate; review any output you rely on. Only translate content you are authorized to process.

Your ChatGPT account, eligibility, data controls, and usage limits remain governed by your agreement with OpenAI. Lunori does not grant model access, sell an OpenAI subscription, or bypass account limits. Fast availability depends on your account and can use more of its limits.

Lunori has no separate account billing or paid plan in this release. You may stop using it and uninstall it at any time. Read the privacy policy for data handling and removal instructions.
